proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s A B C T ht hB hC hAB hs
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hT : T ∈ line[ℝ, A, T] := right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A T
  have hA : A ∈ s := ht.mem_sphere
  have hmA := left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hmB := right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hTA : T ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ hmA)
  have hCA : C ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmA)
  have hCB : C ≠ B := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmB)
  have hOA : s.center ≠ A := by
    intro h
    apply hAB
    have h1 : dist B s.center = s.radius := hB
    have h2 : dist A s.center = s.radius := hA
    rw [h, dist_self] at h2
    rw [h, ← h2, dist_eq_zero] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have h90 : EuclideanGeometry.angle T A s.center = Real.pi / 2 :=
    EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.IsTangentAt.angle_eq_pi_div_two ht hT
  have h2T : (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle T A s.center = (Real.pi : Real.Angle) := by
    rcases EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_or_eq_neg_angle hTA hOA with h | h
    · rw [h, h90, Real.Angle.two_zsmul_coe_div_two]
    · rw [h, h90, smul_neg, Real.Angle.two_zsmul_coe_div_two, Real.Angle.neg_coe_pi]
  have hadd := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_add hTA hOA hAB.symm
  have hpi := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.two_zsmul_oangle_center_add_two_zsmul_oangle_eq_pi hA hC hB hCA hCB hAB
  have h2 : (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle T A B = (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle A C B := by
    rw [← hadd, smul_add, h2T, ← hpi, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rev B A s.center, smul_neg]
    abel
  have hsign : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle T A B).sign = (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A C B).sign := by
    rw [hs.oangle_sign_eq_neg hmA hmB, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_swap₁₂_sign]
  have hne : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle T A B).sign ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hcol := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear.mp h0
    exact hs.2.1 (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAB)
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_iff_oangle_eq_of_sign_eq hTA hAB.symm hCA.symm hCB.symm hsign]
  exact (Real.Angle.two_zsmul_eq_iff_eq hne hsign).mp h2
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B C T : P), s.IsTangentAt A line[ℝ, A, T] → B ∈ s → C ∈ s → A ≠ B → (line[ℝ, A, B]).SOppSide T C → EuclideanGeometry.angle T A B = EuclideanGeometry.angle A C B
